processors.description: Map claude_code assistant_response log events to GenAI semconv. Carries the response text the spans never get, plus request_id as the join key back to claude_code.llm_request spans.

dql.script:
fieldsAdd gen_ai.operation.name = "chat"
| fieldsAdd gen_ai.provider.name = "anthropic"
| fieldsAdd gen_ai.system = "anthropic"
| fieldsAdd gen_ai.response.model = model
| fieldsAdd gen_ai.conversation.id = session.id
| fieldsAdd gen_ai.response.id = request_id
| fieldsAdd tmp_resp_escaped = replaceString(replaceString(replaceString(response, "\\", "\\\\"), "\"", "\\\""), "\n", "\\n")
| fieldsAdd gen_ai.output.messages = concat("[{\"role\":\"assistant\",\"content\":\"", tmp_resp_escaped, "\"}]")
| fieldsRemove tmp_resp_escaped

processors.description: Map claude_code user_prompt log events to GenAI semconv, so the log stream carries both halves of the exchange.

dql.script:
fieldsAdd gen_ai.operation.name = "invoke_agent"
| fieldsAdd gen_ai.provider.name = "anthropic"
| fieldsAdd gen_ai.system = "anthropic"
| fieldsAdd gen_ai.agent.name = "Claude Code"
| fieldsAdd gen_ai.agent.id = "claude-code"
| fieldsAdd gen_ai.conversation.id = session.id
| fieldsAdd tmp_prompt_escaped = replaceString(replaceString(replaceString(prompt, "\\", "\\\\"), "\"", "\\\""), "\n", "\\n")
| fieldsAdd gen_ai.input.messages = concat("[{\"role\":\"user\",\"content\":\"", tmp_prompt_escaped, "\"}]")
| fieldsRemove tmp_prompt_escaped
